name: begin_question
description: Call this immediately before asking the expert any question, every time, then speak the question. Links the question to the pointing event it is about.

event_id.description: The event_id of the pointing event the question is about (for example evt-001). Use "none" when the question is not about any pointing event.

kind.description: The kind of question: explain, reasoning, distinction, context, guardrail, exception, clarify_reference (which region do you mean) or gap.

question.description: The exact question you are about to ask, as you will say it.
